profile.headline: HPC Research Software Engineer
profile.summary: Quantitative Scientist with a proven track record in the financial services industry, Oil & Gas sector, and academia. Possessing strong expertise in applied mathematics and computer science, with a particular focus on high-performance software engineering, parallel computing, and software development. Specializes in creating and optimizing mathematical applications, including forward models, inverse problems, and physics simulations. Passionate about developing financial models for quantitative trading, leveraging advanced techniques to drive innovative trading strategies.

company.name: NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration

positions.title: Quantitative Researcher
positions.description: Skills: SQL · ETFs · Statistical Analysis · C++ · Trading Systems · Python (Programming Language) · Financial Modeling

positions.title: Senior Research Scientist
positions.description: Skills: High Performance Computing (HPC) · Market Microstructure · SQL · Statistical Analysis · Optimization Techniques · C++ · Trading Systems · Python (Programming Language) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Financial Modeling

positions.title: Senior Quantitative HPC Engineer
positions.description: Skills: High Performance Computing (HPC) · SQL · Optimization Techniques · C++

positions.title: Senior High Performance Computing Architect.
positions.description: Working on high performance computing for the calculation of velocity models in seismic tomography. Solution of large-scale inverse problems. Developed next generation software for both cluster and cloud computing.
positions.insights: Skills: High Performance Computing (HPC) · Optimization Techniques · C++

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Supported the High-Order Method Modeling Environment (HOMME), a highly scalable dynamical core for CFD of the Earth's atmosphere. Developed new implementations of Cloud Resolving Models (CRM) for GPUs in CUDA. Researched and evaluated new computing platforms such as Intel MIC for next generation climate models.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Principal Developer of the Milne-Eddington gRid Linear Inversion Network (MERLIN), a High-Performance application for determining the magnetic field in the solar photosphere (inverse-problem).

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Developer with the Earth System Grid (ESG), an initiative of the office of science of the United States Department of Energy for the management and distribution of petascale data produced by climate models.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Principal Developer of Coupling, Energetics and Dynamics of Atmospheric Regions (CEDAR), a large Relational Database and related server applications for world-wide instruments measuring the Ionosphere.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Provided UTF-8 support for inter-process communication in telecommunication applications that were developed for single byte characters.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Project for Peoplesoft-Vantive before it was acquired by Oracle. Developed server side software to allow the Front-End client applications to access critical information in relational databases in the execution of business logic.
